scenes.text: A net is a two-dimensional arrangement of faces that folds into a solid. Count and position all faces.
For the net of a rectangular prism, how many flat faces must be represented? The answer is 6. A rectangular prism has 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices and two matching end faces.
A child on a football field draws a flat net to fold a triangular prism. How many flat faces will the finished shape have? Pause to choose and explain.

A child on a football field draws a flat net to fold a triangular prism. How many flat faces will the finished shape have? The answer is 5. A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges, 6 vertices and two matching end faces.
